purpose: Sharpen the projectively-distinct rank-four support bound from the trivial 40 points of PG(3,3) to 19 edges by an exact Fourier character count of signed zero sums. This converts the genuinely new rank-four graphic frontier into a small finite support regime without enumerating sign assignments.

setup.matrix: A is an r by m rank-r GF(3) matrix with nonzero columns a_1,...,a_m.
setup.character: Fix a primitive complex cube root omega. For lambda in GF(3)^r, the additive character is chi_lambda(y)=omega^(lambda dot y).

fourier_identity.name: SIGNED_ZERO_COUNT_BY_ORTHOGONAL_HYPERPLANE_COUNTS
derivation: Insert additive-character orthogonality into N0 and interchange the sign and character sums.
For one column a, sum_{epsilon in {+1,-1}} omega^(epsilon lambda dot a) equals 2 when lambda dot a=0 and equals omega+omega^(-1)=-1 otherwise.
Let z_lambda be the number of columns orthogonal to lambda. Then N0(A)=3^(-r) sum_lambda 2^(z_lambda) (-1)^(m-z_lambda).

projectively_distinct_specialization.hypothesis: The nonzero columns of A occupy distinct projective points of PG(r-1,3).
projectively_distinct_specialization.hyperplanes: Every nonzero lambda defines one projective hyperplane H_lambda={ [a] : lambda dot a=0 }, and lambda and -lambda define the same H.
projectively_distinct_specialization.count: The number of projective hyperplanes is P_r=(3^r-1)/2.
projectively_distinct_specialization.capacity: A projective hyperplane is PG(r-2,3) and contains H_r=(3^(r-1)-1)/2 points, so z_lambda<=H_r.
projectively_distinct_specialization.formula: N0(A)=3^(-r) * (2^m + 2 * SUM_H 2^(h_H) * (-1)^(m-h_H)), where h_H is the number of selected projective columns in H.

rank4_theorem.threshold: At m=20, 2^20=1,048,576 while 80*2^13=655,360, so the lower bound is strictly positive. It only increases thereafter.
rank4_theorem.statement: Every rank-four GF(3) matrix with projectively distinct nonzero columns and zero-free sign image has m<=19.
rank4_theorem.scope: This theorem is algebraic and does not require graphic structure beyond what is used later. It is an exact existence bound, not a probabilistic estimate.

consistency_controls.rank2: The same coarse bound gives m<=4 for r=2, matching the largest abstract zero-free four-singleton PG(1,3) pattern in v5.8.
consistency_controls.rank3: The bound gives m<=8 for r=3; the exact PG(2,3) enumeration in v5.9 sharpens this by one to m<=7. This is a replay sanity check on the character bound rather than a replacement for v5.9.

graphic_rank4_corollary.minimality_input: By v6.1, a rank-minimal zero-free rank-four simple-graphic projection has no repeated nonzero projective columns.
graphic_rank4_corollary.support_bound: Therefore its nonzero-column support graph has at most 19 edges.
graphic_rank4_corollary.no_bridges: Every support edge is used by some row flow, hence the support graph has no bridges, as in v5.9.
graphic_rank4_corollary.noncolourable: Zero-freeness implies the support graph is not 3-colourable: any proper 3-colouring would produce a nowhere-zero tension annihilated by every row flow.
graphic_rank4_corollary.K4_free: If the support contains a K4, its three-dimensional cycle space gives the already classified rank-three zero-free K4 certificate. Thus a genuinely rank-minimal rank-four obstruction may be assumed K4-free.
graphic_rank4_corollary.finite_frontier: The new rank-four support problem is confined to simple, bridgeless, K4-free, non-3-colourable graphs with at most 19 edges, together with a projectively distinct rank-four flow subspace.

positive: Cuts the distinct rank-four projective search space from at most 40 support edges to at most 19 by one closed-form character estimate.
Combined with v6.1, every genuinely new rank-four linear syndrome certificate is a constant-size graphic obstruction.
The bound uses only hyperplane incidence counts and does not enumerate the 2^m sign cube.
not_killed: One or more genuinely new rank-four obstructions inside the <=19-edge finite frontier.
Rank-five and higher minimal syndrome certificates.

next_target.name: E8_GRAPHIC_RANK4_19EDGE_CRITICAL_SUPPORT_CLASSIFICATION_V6_3
next_target.directive: Classify the remaining simple bridgeless K4-free non-3-colourable supports with at most 19 edges that can carry a projectively distinct rank-four zero-free flow projection. Use 4-critical reduction, graph-flow constraints and PG(3,3) incidence before any sign enumeration. Determine whether the frontier is empty or identify a finite explicit obstruction family with polynomial recognition and replay.
